author: Trekkerac / happykeys
coordinate_system: Blender right-handed XYZ, Z up; all lengths in metres; model-local origin on ground.
unity_coordinate_mapping: (x,y,z) Blender -> (x,z,-y) Unity with FBX -Z forward/Y up. Proxy coordinates are model-local; ignore master lineup translations.
original_size_policy: Use imported GLB world-space mesh extents before recentering; preserve baked source rotation/nonuniform scale, then one uniform scale factor.
rock_size_policy: 0.3-2.5 m measured by maximum bounding-box extent. Below 0.4 m: decorative, zero colliders.
collider_policy: Analytic primitive definitions and hidden wire debug meshes in the prepared blend, not engine components or meshes embedded in FBXs. One conservative capsule per primary trunk; additional thick basal branch capsules only where branch surface reaches below 2.5 m. Thin twigs around 0.10 m diameter omitted. One bounds box per nondecorative rock.

recolour.bark_adjustment: HSV saturation x0.30, value x0.94, retain hue; then +0.012 to sRGB blue. Task-specific cold grey-brown adaptation, not the unmodified v07 bark swatch.
recolour.method: Flat v07-derived swatches with roughness 0.9; source palette UVs retained. FBXs keep the original source palette.
